item.title: Describe What Is Happening Near the Gate
item.prompt_text: You can see a market gate. A woman is playing a guitar by the gate. Two children are standing next to her, and a man is putting money into a hat. Tell a friend what you can see.
item.target_grammar: Present continuous for actions and next to or by for position.
item.fluency_objective: Say one line for each person or group. Listen back and check whether you used an action word every time.
item.pronunciation_objective: Stress guitar, children and hat so your listener can follow the new details.

cues.text: Say where the musician is and what she is doing.
Say what the children are doing.

item.model_opening: I can see a woman by the market gate.
item.model_answer: I can see a woman by the market gate. She is playing a guitar. Two children are standing next to her. There is a man with a hat. He is putting money into it.
